page.name: settings
page.div: All settings live here. Changes save through the standard Save button at the top — they round-trip through ir.config_parameter, so the legacy Website → Configuration → Settings panels stay in sync.

The agent carries the provider, model, and API key — all configured in the AI app (Odoo Enterprise). Leave the picker empty to fall back to the site's "Ask AI" agent. The SEO house-style rules are sent with every request, so a generic agent works fine.
Auto-publish runs every 3 days. The agent picks a current trend in your domain, writes the article, publishes it, and emails the SEO Manager group with the link.

On a "page not found", the visitor is sent to the closest matching existing URL (fuzzy match against the sitemap). When no close match is found, the 404 is logged and — if Send unmatched 404s home is on — the visitor goes to the home page; turn that off to keep a real 404 for unmatched pages.

ol.li: Open Google Cloud Console and create (or pick) a project.
Under APIs & Services → Library, enable Search Console API.
Configure the OAuth consent screen (Internal or External).
Under Credentials, create an OAuth client ID — Web application.
Add the Authorized Redirect URI shown above to the OAuth client — exact match, including https and no trailing slash.
Paste the Client ID and Client Secret into the fields above and save.
Open ERA SEO Suite → GSC → Accounts → New, then click Connect with Google.

group.div: Have the AI agent walk every page and blog post on your site and fill the empty SEO fields (title, description, OG/Twitter, keywords) for each one. Runs in the background — 10 records every 2 minutes — so closing this page is safe; the cron keeps going until the queue is empty, then stops itself.

button.name: action_start_bulk_ai_fill
button.confirm: Start the AI Bulk Fill cron now? Runs in the background — 10 records every 2 minutes — until the queue is empty.

group.div: Tip: budget-wise, the agent does 1 call per record per active language. Watch your provider dashboard if you have hundreds of pages.

Lets the AI cron classify your existing blog posts into categories (and series, when the post is clearly part of a multi-part arc) at the same time it fills the SEO fields. Existing taxonomy is preferred over creating new rows.

The same cron that runs AI Bulk Fill also processes blog posts in batches of 10 every 2 minutes. If you haven't started the bulk fill yet, turning this on doesn't start it on its own — click Start AI Bulk Fill above.

button.name: action_cleanup_old_runs_now
button.confirm: Delete every audit-run row older than the configured retention. The findings they discovered (with their AI suggestions and resolution status) are kept. Continue?

page.div: Each scan creates a fresh row in SEO Audits. The defects themselves persist as Findings across all runs — deleting old runs only removes the per-run summary, never the findings. Default retention: 90 days. Set to 0 to keep everything.

page.name: guide
page.div: On-page setup walkthroughs. Click a section to expand. To re-run the guided setup, use the Setup Wizard button in the header above.

ol.li: Install Odoo's AI app (Enterprise) and configure a provider with an API key.
Settings → ERA SEO — AI Auto-Fix: tick Enable, pick the "ERA SEO Fixer" agent, click Test Agent.
On any audit finding (or in batch), click Suggest Fix (AI) → review → Apply Fix.
On pages / posts / content blocks, use AI: Fill SEO / AI: Rewrite SEO in the form header.
Toggle Publish /llms.txt above; set a one-line site summary.
Open the GEO tab → Manage AI Crawlers; flip Allowed off on training-only bots if you want to block them from robots.txt.
Verify the live output: https://<domain>/llms.txt and the AI section in /robots.txt.
Run an SEO Audit; GEO checks (no answer summary, no headings, llms.txt off, answer-bots blocked) appear alongside SEO findings.
In Google Cloud Console: create a project; enable Search Console API.
Create OAuth 2.0 Client (Web app); add Redirect URI <base>/era_gsc/oauth/callback.
In Odoo: Settings → ERA SEO — Google Search Console; paste Client ID + Secret.
Open the GSC tab → Accounts → New → Connect with Google; grant read access.
Sites are auto-discovered; click Pull Now on a site to fill in queries.
